title: Enterprise Network Vulnerability Assessment Report
executive_summary: An automated network security assessment of target host 127.0.0.1 was conducted evaluating 103 TCP ports in Curated (103) mode. The assessment discovered 4 active listening service(s), with the maximum detected exposure reaching None severity and an overall risk score of 5/100 (Low Risk). Identified services exhibited low-to-medium risk profiles with no direct high-severity CVE matches mapped in active service banners. Top Priority Remediation: Restrict TCP port 135 to internal administrative jump hosts and domain controllers; block external inbound access.

findings.remediation: Restrict TCP port 135 to internal administrative jump hosts and domain controllers; block external inbound access.
findings.title: Active Service: Microsoft Windows RPC Endpoint Mapper on Port 135/TCP
findings.finding_title: Active Service: Microsoft Windows RPC Endpoint Mapper on Port 135/TCP
findings.description: TCP port 135 was confirmed in the OPEN state via TCP SYN/connect handshake. Protocol probing extracted banner: "Microsoft Windows RPC Endpoint Mapper". Identified software product: Microsoft. Mapped host process: svchost.exe (PID: 1480). No active public CVEs directly mapped in NIST NVD for this service banner.

findings.remediation: Disable SMBv1 host-wide; apply latest Microsoft security updates; isolate port 445 to trusted administrative subnets via perimeter firewall.

findings.remediation: Audit listening service configuration, restrict access to authorized IP addresses, and apply latest security patches.
